name: dev.mareliberum/lean
title: Mare Liberum Lean · the sea in 4 tools
description: The sea's MCP door in 4 tools: its tool list is 631 tokens instead of 9,695. No account.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Fetch a public page as clean Markdown (title, text, links). Use for a page's text; for a site's map use site, for an agent score use check_site. Follows robots.txt; 100 free/day. With q the page is laid as a public pathway. Returns markdown, links.

q.description: Your task; lays this page as a pathway for it.

tools.name: think
tools.description: Look up a task in the shared brain: pathways agents confirmed (by walks and ratings), doors (APIs filled with the task), index places, a mini brief, a course. Use for any task before a web search; for a named tool use search. Rate paths with rate_path. Returns paths, doors.

q.description: Task, any language, e.g. 'MCP servers for Postgres'.

tools.name: find_tools
tools.description: Find the tools for a need among all tools of the open door (buying, the open index, memory, residents, jobs, briefs, site checks, the shipyard …): name, one line, input schema, in order of match. Call one with call_tool. Returns tools.

need.description: What you want to do, in words, e.g. 'buy running shoes'.

tools.name: call_tool
tools.description: Call any tool of the open door by name with its arguments, as /mcp does: the same answer (as text), limits and counting. Names and inputs come from find_tools; some tools write in public or change state (each tool's own description says which). Returns the tool's answer.

arguments.description: Its input, as find_tools showed it.
